episodes.title: I Didn't Join a Cult. I Joined a Church.
episodes.description: For 28 years, I believed I was serving the Divine. I followed the rules, silenced my questions, and ignored the quiet voice inside me that kept whispering something wasn't right. This isn't a story about attacking faith. It's a story about what happens when control is mistaken for spirituality and fear replaces freedom. In this deeply personal episode of Unchurched, I share the journey I never thought I would tell publicly—the emotional, psychological, and spiritual wounds that kept me trapped for nearly three decades. You'll hear the moments that broke me, the questions that changed everything, and how I found my way back to the God within me instead of the fear that had defined my relationship with religion. If you've ever felt guilty for asking questions, afraid to leave, or wondered whether your faith belonged to you or to someone else, this conversation may help you realize you're not losing your faith—you may finally be finding it. This isn't about leaving God. It's about leaving what stood between you and the Divine. Subscribe to Unchurched: Where Truth Breaks Tradition and join the conversation as we explore religious trauma, spiritual healing, and the courage to reclaim your own voice.

episodes.title: Church Hurt Changed Everything | Religious Trauma, Spiritual Abuse & Finding Freedom
episodes.description: Have you ever questioned your faith because of church hurt? Have you experienced spiritual abuse, religious manipulation, or been used by the very people you trusted? In this episode of Unchurched, Edna White sits down with Stephanie C. Jones, who shares her powerful journey of surviving religious trauma and reclaiming her identity after years of serving in ministry. Raised in the church, Stephanie faithfully served as a youth pastor, Sunday School superintendent, and worship leader. But behind the scenes, her gifts were exploited, her voice was overlooked, and she eventually found herself discarded by the very community she had devoted her life to. Today, Stephanie helps others heal from toxic church experiences by embracing wholeness, wellness, and authentic faith without manipulation or control. If you've struggled with church hurt, faith deconstruction, religious abuse, toxic leadership, or are searching for healing after leaving the church, this conversation will remind you that your story isn't over. In this episode you'll discover: • The warning signs of spiritual abuse and toxic church culture • How religious trauma impacts your identity and relationships • The difference between faith and religious control • Practical steps toward healing and emotional freedom • Why walking away from abuse doesn't mean walking away from God Subscribe to Unchurched for honest conversations about church hurt, spiritual healing, faith, and living free from religious manipulation. If this conversation resonated with you, don't let your healing stop here. Church hurt, spiritual abuse, and religious trauma don't have to define the rest of your life. Healing is possible, but it requires a decision to move forward with intention.
